testJudgment.assertionOrderDetail: Line 239 captures liveDelivery but does not assert it. Line 259 asserts recoveredDelivery against the literal redacted map FIRST. Line 265 then asserts recoveredDelivery equals liveDelivery. This ordering is correct and matches the artefact's claim: had the live literal been asserted first, a mutation that strips the recovery-path redaction could die on the live assertion without the recovery claim ever being exercised. As implemented, the recovered-path assertion is the one that must independently hold.
testJudgment.nonDestructiveDetail: Lines 269-271 re-read the durable event log after the recovered assertions and confirm the persisted GameCreated still carries both snapshot ids, proving redaction is per-delivery and not a mutation of the stored history.

rewindUnreachabilityAssessment.claim: The boot-time rewind fold (tryFoldActivatedRewindBranch) is structurally unreachable for a match stream on this head because a genuinely-activated rewind branch's parent segment traces back to the baseline branch id 'main', and matchStoreBranchSegmentReader refuses every branch id but 'root'.
rewindUnreachabilityAssessment.verdict: CORRECT, verified by direct code reading

citationsVerified.confirmedText: 'unknown-branch', `A match store holds only the '${ROOT_EVENT_BRANCH_ID}' branch; '${segment.branchId}' has no events`

export async function tryFoldActivatedRewindBranch at line 131; body early-returns null when head is null or isLivePathBranchId(head.branchId), otherwise calls readActivatedBranchGameEvents -> resolveBranchPath -> materializeBranchPath(matchStoreBranchSegmentReader(store), path)
const rewound = await tryFoldActivatedRewindBranch(store, meta.matchId); ... catch (e) { console.warn(...) } path lands the match in `failed`

additionalLogicVerified.isLivePathBranchIdSet: LIVE_PATH_BRANCH_IDS = {MATCH_BASELINE_BRANCH_ID ('main'), ROOT_EVENT_BRANCH_ID ('root')} (matchAuthorityBaseline.ts lines 81-84). isLivePathBranchId(branchId) returns true only for these two.
additionalLogicVerified.reasoning: tryFoldActivatedRewindBranch (ServerMatchHostRewindRebuild.ts:141-143) early-returns null when head.branchId is 'main' or 'root' — this is the fix that lets a never-rewound, freshly-mirrored match (which sits on 'main') recover normally without hitting the reader's refusal; the file's own doc comment (lines 120-129) explicitly says this refusal 'used to fail the whole match at boot' for that live-path case. But a match that has gone through an ACTUAL rewind (acquireCorrectionLease -> createCorrectionCandidateBranch -> activateCandidateBranch -> supersedeFrom) has an effective head on the candidate branch id, which is NOT in LIVE_PATH_BRANCH_IDS, so the early return does not fire; execution proceeds into readActivatedBranchGameEvents -> resolveBranchPath, whose resolved path's parent segment still names the baseline 'main' (since every candidate's parent is the baseline), and matchStoreBranchSegmentReader.read() throws unknown-branch for any branchId other than 'root'. This is a different, narrower code path than the one already fixed, and it is exactly what the artefact's probe reproduced (error text 'A match store holds only the root branch; main has no events' matches the reader's throw message verbatim).
